title: PR #43: fix(l1): restore canonical blockchain API integration
content:
State: closed
Merged: True
Draft: False

Fixes the concrete CI failures found in the canonical L1 path.

Changes:
- use the exported `atc_blockchain::Node` API in atc-node and E2E tests
- update network E2E tests to send `NetworkMessage::Block(Block)`, matching the canonical network API
- import `PeerTransport` where trait-method broadcast is used
- update the block-reward unit assertion to the current Result-returning API

This is driven by actual GitHub Actions failures from L1 Network E2E and Blockchain Core Integration. No consensus rule changes are introduced.
